method: Closed welcome + setup disclosure: actual filled four-region Dallas treemap vs all visible text ranges. Headings, chart labels, buttons and instructions count as text; overlapping text is subtracted from graphic fill, so it is not double-counted. Whitespace/card backgrounds and decorative outlines never count. Global masthead, following tickers/finder/report, and unopened setup content are outside this landing observation.
